headline: Tabled FY27 budget discussion after approving $2,500 for ArtCity Nashua and creating a new Music at the Pavilion subcommittee.
summary: The commission discussed reappointments, the Summer Music Series, and the Arts Kiosk panels. It created a subcommittee called Music at the Pavilion and discussed the FY27 budget, including $2,500 for ArtCity Nashua and $2,000 for an NEA Arts Study, then tabled the budget discussion.
decisions: Created a subcommittee called Music at the Pavilion, with Chuck abstaining.
Approved $2,500 for ArtCity Nashua as part of the FY27 budget.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to create subcommittee called "Music at the Pavilion": Motion was made by Judy and seconded by Lindsay, all in favor with Chuck abstaining
Motion to Table was made by Jane, seconded by Judy, all in favor, Motion carried.

plain_text:
Nashua Arts Commission 
Meeting minutes 
August 11, 2026 
In attendance: 
Jennifer Annand 
Judy Carlson 
Sara Ceaser 
Chuck Emmons  
Paula Lochhead 
Faith Mandravelis 
Jane Marquis 
Lindsay Rinaldi 
Lauren Spira-Savett
 
Absent: Tina Cassidy, Stephanie Moll 
City reps: Liz Hannum, Alderman-at-Large Morgan, Alderman Ravan 
 
Call to Order: 8:04 am. Roll Call of Members. 
Motion to Approve: June 2026 minutes – Motion to Approve was made by Jane and seconded by Judy, all in 
favor. Motion carried. 
Chairman’s Report 
Discussion on reappointments and waitlist for commission. Start conversation about moving the Arts 
Commission budget out of the CAC and into the General Fund going forward. 
Old Business 
Summer Music Series update: Faith relayed the feedback she’s been receiving and the remaining 
budget to be used. 
Motion to create subcommittee called “Music at the Pavilion”: Motion was made by Judy and seconded by 
Lindsay, all in favor with Chuck abstaining: the agenda for that committee is as follows: 
• Go over feedback from 2026 season 
• Determine if there is remaining funds and what to do with them 
• Lay out next steps for how to make next year easier 
Committee members include: Faith, Laurie, Amber, Lindsay and Sara 
Arts Kiosk update: Ordering new panels for the existing 4-sided stands 
 
 
MORE
New Business 
FY27 Budget Discussion:  
Starting with $45,000 this year 
$2,500 approved for ArtCity Nashua 
$2,000 discussed for NEA Arts Study 
Remainder will be divided between grants and Arts Commission projects TBD 
Motion to Table was made by Jane, seconded by Judy, all in favor, Motion carried. 
 
Motion to Adjourn: 9:21 am, made by Faith, seconded by Judy, all in favor. Motion carried. 
 
Next Meeting:  8 am Tuesday, September 8, 2026
